theme: 教材字彙・基礎 550–650 第 9 群

items.colloc: particularly important 特別重要 | particularly concerned 特別擔心
items.distinct: especially 特別地 | specifically 明確地
ex: The manager was particularly impressed by her presentation.
經理對她的簡報特別印象深刻。
Pricing is particularly important in this competitive market.
在競爭激烈的市場中，定價顯得特別重要。
We are particularly concerned about the recent budget cuts.
我們對於近期的預算刪減感到特別擔憂。

items.pos: v. 通過；傳遞 | n. 通行證
items.colloc: pass the exam 通過考試 | security pass 安全通行證
items.distinct: approve 核准 | surpass 超過
ex: Please pass the documents to the legal department.
請將文件傳遞給法務部門。
Candidates must pass the initial screening to continue.
候選人必須通過初篩才能繼續。
Do not forget to wear your security pass at work.
上班時別忘了佩戴你的通行證。

items.colloc: online platform 線上平台 | train platform 火車月台
items.distinct: stage 舞台 | podium 講台
ex: Our company uses a new platform for remote collaboration.
我們公司使用一個新平台進行遠端協作。
Please wait for the train on platform number four.
請在四號月台等待火車。
This digital platform improves our communication efficiency.
這個數位平台提升了我們的溝通效率。

items.pos: adj. 潛在的 | n. 潛力
items.colloc: potential client 潛在客戶 | reach your potential 發揮潛力
items.distinct: possible 可能的 | latent 潛伏的
ex: We have identified several potential risks in the project.
我們已確認專案中幾個潛在的風險。
The new employee shows great potential for leadership.
這位新員工展現出極大的領導潛力。
Investors are looking for companies with potential growth.
投資者正在尋找具有潛在成長性的公司。

items.colloc: previously mentioned 先前提到的 | previously occupied 先前佔用的
items.distinct: formerly 以前 | already 已經
ex: The office was previously occupied by the sales team.
這間辦公室先前是由業務團隊使用。
I have previously worked with this consulting firm.
我先前曾與這家顧問公司合作過。
As previously mentioned, the deadline has been extended.
如先前提到的，截止日期已經延後了。

items.colloc: reply promptly 迅速回覆 | arrive promptly 準時到達
items.distinct: quickly 很快 | punctually 準時地
ex: Please reply to all customer inquiries promptly.
請迅速回覆所有客戶的詢問。
The meeting will start promptly at nine o'clock.
會議將在九點準時開始。
Maintenance staff arrived promptly to fix the broken printer.
維修人員迅速抵達以修復壞掉的印表機。

items.colloc: properly trained 受過適當訓練 | function properly 正常運作
items.distinct: correctly 正確地 | appropriately 合適地
ex: Ensure that all equipment is stored properly after use.
確保所有設備在使用後都適當存放。
The new software is not functioning properly today.
這套新軟體今天無法正常運作。
Staff must be properly trained before using heavy machinery.
員工在使用重型機具前必須受過適當訓練。

items.colloc: highly qualified 高度合格的 | qualified candidate 合格候選人
items.distinct: competent 有能力的 | certified 認證的
ex: We are looking for a highly qualified accountant.
我們正在尋找一位高度合格的會計師。
She is well qualified for the management position.
她非常有資格勝任這個管理職位。
Only qualified applicants will be invited for an interview.
只有合格的申請者會被邀請參加面試。

items.pos: v. 取得資格；使具備資格
items.colloc: qualify for a loan 符合貸款資格 | qualify as an expert 具備專家資格
items.distinct: certify 證明 | authorize 授權
ex: You must meet certain criteria to qualify for the bonus.
你必須符合特定標準才能取得獎金資格。
This certification will qualify you for higher positions.
這張證照將讓你具備擔任更高職位的資格。
Do you qualify for the company health insurance plan?
你符合公司健康保險方案的資格嗎？

items.pos: n. 品質；特質 | adj. 優質的
items.colloc: high quality 高品質 | quality control 品質控管
items.distinct: quantity 數量 | character 特性
ex: Our company is known for maintaining high quality standards.
我們公司以維持高品質標準而聞名。
Quality control is essential for our manufacturing process.
品質控管對於我們的製造流程至關重要。
We need to improve the quality of our customer service.
我們需要提升客戶服務的品質。

items.colloc: growing rapidly 迅速成長 | changing rapidly 快速改變
items.distinct: fast 快速地 | quickly 迅速地
ex: The demand for our services is growing rapidly.
我們對服務的需求正在迅速成長。
Technology is changing rapidly in the modern workplace.
在現代職場中科技正迅速地改變。
Our team is expanding rapidly to meet new project goals.
我們的團隊正迅速擴張以達成新專案目標。

items.colloc: reach an agreement 達成協議 | reach out to 聯繫
items.distinct: arrive 到達 | contact 聯繫
ex: We hope to reach an agreement by the end of Friday.
我們希望在週五前達成協議。
Please reach out to the supplier regarding the delay.
關於延誤的事宜，請聯繫供應商。
The company aims to reach new markets next year.
公司目標明年開發新的市場。

items.colloc: work remotely 遠端工作 | remotely accessed 遠端存取
items.distinct: distantly 遙遠地 | far 遠地
ex: Many employees prefer the option to work remotely.
許多員工偏好遠端工作的選項。
The server can be accessed remotely by the IT team.
伺服器可以由 IT 團隊進行遠端存取。
We conduct our weekly meetings remotely using video software.
我們透過視訊軟體以遠端方式進行每週會議。

items.colloc: required documents 必要文件 | required field 必填欄位
items.distinct: necessary 必要的 | mandatory 強制的
ex: Please submit all required documents by next Monday.
請在下週一前繳交所有必要文件。
Completion of this training course is required for all staff.
所有員工都必須完成這門培訓課程。
Check the online form to see the required fields.
檢查線上表單以確認必填欄位。

items.pos: n. 獎勵；報酬 | v. 獎賞
items.colloc: financial reward 金錢報酬 | reward hard work 獎勵辛勤工作
items.distinct: prize 獎品 | bonus 獎金
ex: The company offers a reward for excellent sales performance.
公司提供獎勵給表現優異的業務。
Hard work should be rewarded with fair compensation.
辛勤工作應獲得合理的報酬。
They received a cash reward for finishing the project early.
他們因為提早完成專案而獲得現金獎勵。

items.colloc: security guard 保全人員 | job security 工作保障
items.distinct: safety 安全（防意外）| protection 保護
ex: Security measures have been tightened at the office entrance.
辦公室入口處已加強安全措施。
Employees are concerned about their long-term job security.
員工們擔心他們長期的工作保障。
Please show your ID to the security guard at the desk.
請出示證件給櫃檯的保全人員。

items.colloc: significant increase 顯著成長 | significant impact 重要影響
items.distinct: important 重要的 | substantial 大量的
ex: The company saw a significant increase in quarterly profits.
公司看見了季盈餘的顯著成長。
New regulations will have a significant impact on our business.
新法規將對我們的業務產生重大影響。
There is a significant difference between the two proposals.
這兩個提案之間有顯著的差異。

items.colloc: speak to the manager 與經理談話 | speak at a conference 在會議中發言
items.distinct: talk 談話 | say 說（話的內容）
ex: I need to speak with you regarding the new project.
我需要跟你談談關於新專案的事。
She will speak at the upcoming international business conference.
她將在即將到來的國際商業會議中發言。
It is important to speak clearly during the presentation.
在簡報過程中說話清晰很重要。

items.colloc: spend money on 花錢在... | spend time working 花時間工作
items.distinct: cost 花費（指金額）| waste 浪費
ex: We spend too much time on unnecessary administrative tasks.
我們花太多時間在不必要的行政工作上。
The company decided to spend more on marketing campaigns.
公司決定在行銷活動上花費更多。
Employees often spend hours preparing for the weekly meeting.
員工常花好幾個小時準備每週會議。

items.colloc: succeed in business 在商業上成功 | succeed the CEO 繼任執行長
items.distinct: success 成功（名詞）| successful 成功的（形容詞）
ex: Hard work and determination will help you succeed.
辛勤工作與決心將幫助你成功。
She was chosen to succeed the retiring director next month.
她被選為下個月繼任退休的總監。
To succeed in this market, we need a better strategy.
為了在這個市場成功，我們需要更好的策略。
